model.rawSql:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT now() AS evaluated_at,
           now() - interval '17 minutes' AS cohort_start,
           now() - interval '2 minutes' AS cohort_end
), configured_cities(city_slug) AS (
    VALUES ('atlanta'), ('washington-dc'), ('boston'), ('new-york-city'),
           ('toronto'), ('philadelphia'), ('denver'), ('seattle'), ('unknown')
), configured_journeys(journey) AS (
    VALUES ('bootstrap_start'), ('city_map_start'), ('live_start'), ('live_resume'),
           ('audio_unlock'), ('audio_resume'), ('settings_effect'), ('settings_persistence'),
           ('audio_stop'), ('city_navigation')
), configured_environments(environment) AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT environment
    FROM client_experience_events
    WHERE environment <> 'synthetic'
    UNION SELECT 'Production'
), starts AS (
    SELECT e.environment, e.city_slug, e.page_session_id, e.city_activation_id,
           e.measurement_version, e.attempt_id,
           MIN(e.received_at_utc) AS received_at_utc,
           COUNT(*) AS event_count,
           BOOL_OR(e.clock_skewed OR e.received_at_utc < e.occurred_at_utc
               OR e.received_at_utc - e.occurred_at_utc > interval '2 minutes') AS stale_start,
           MIN(COALESCE(e.payload ->> 'journey', e.payload ->> 'action')) AS series_code
    FROM client_experience_events e
    CROSS JOIN parameters p
    WHERE e.event_kind = 'attempt_started'
      AND e.attempt_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.environment <> 'synthetic'
      AND e.received_at_utc BETWEEN p.cohort_start AND p.cohort_end
    GROUP BY e.environment, e.city_slug, e.page_session_id, e.city_activation_id,
             e.measurement_version, e.attempt_id
), finishes AS (
    SELECT e.environment, e.page_session_id, e.city_activation_id, e.measurement_version, e.attempt_id,
           COUNT(*) AS event_count,
           BOOL_OR(e.clock_skewed OR e.received_at_utc < e.occurred_at_utc
               OR e.received_at_utc - e.occurred_at_utc > interval '2 minutes') AS stale_result
    FROM client_experience_events e
    JOIN starts s
      ON s.environment = e.environment
     AND s.page_session_id = e.page_session_id
     AND s.city_activation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.city_activation_id
     AND s.measurement_version = e.measurement_version
     AND s.attempt_id = e.attempt_id
    WHERE e.event_kind = 'attempt_finished'
      AND e.attempt_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.environment <> 'synthetic'
    GROUP BY e.environment, e.page_session_id, e.city_activation_id, e.measurement_version, e.attempt_id
), attempts AS (
    SELECT s.environment, s.city_slug, s.page_session_id, s.series_code,
           a.eligible, a.logical_conflict, s.stale_start, s.event_count AS start_event_count,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.stale_result, false) THEN 'unresolved' ELSE a.outcome END AS effective_outcome
    FROM starts s
    JOIN client_experience_attempts a
      ON a.environment = s.environment
     AND a.page_session_id = s.page_session_id
     AND a.city_activation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.city_activation_id
     AND a.measurement_version = s.measurement_version
     AND a.attempt_id = s.attempt_id
    LEFT JOIN finishes f
      ON f.environment = s.environment
     AND f.page_session_id = s.page_session_id
     AND f.city_activation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.city_activation_id
     AND f.measurement_version = s.measurement_version
     AND f.attempt_id = s.attempt_id
), totals AS (
    SELECT environment, city_slug, series_code,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE eligible AND NOT logical_conflict AND NOT stale_start AND start_event_count = 1
               AND effective_outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','deadline_exceeded','unresolved')) AS eligible_starts,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE eligible AND NOT logical_conflict AND NOT stale_start AND start_event_count = 1
               AND effective_outcome IN ('failed','deadline_exceeded')) AS bad_starts,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE eligible AND NOT logical_conflict AND NOT stale_start AND start_event_count = 1
               AND effective_outcome = 'unresolved') AS unresolved_starts,
           COUNT(DISTINCT page_session_id) FILTER (WHERE eligible AND NOT logical_conflict AND NOT stale_start AND start_event_count = 1
               AND effective_outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','deadline_exceeded','unresolved')) AS affected_sessions
    FROM attempts
    GROUP BY environment, city_slug, series_code
), fixed_series AS (
    SELECT e.environment, c.city_slug, j.journey,
           COALESCE(t.eligible_starts, 0) AS eligible_starts,
           COALESCE(t.bad_starts, 0) AS bad_starts,
           COALESCE(t.unresolved_starts, 0) AS unresolved_starts,
           COALESCE(t.affected_sessions, 0) AS affected_sessions
    FROM configured_environments e
    CROSS JOIN configured_cities c
    CROSS JOIN configured_journeys j
    LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.environment = e.environment AND t.city_slug = c.city_slug AND t.series_code = j.journey
)
SELECT p.evaluated_at AS "time", s.environment, s.city_slug, s.journey,
       CASE WHEN s.eligible_starts >= 20
                  AND s.affected_sessions >= 3
                  AND s.unresolved_starts::numeric / NULLIF(s.eligible_starts, 0) <= 0.10
            THEN CASE WHEN s.bad_starts::numeric / NULLIF(s.eligible_starts, 0) >= 0.10
                      THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END
            ELSE NULL::double precision END AS value
FROM fixed_series s
CROSS JOIN parameters p
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4;

WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT now() AS evaluated_at,
           now() - interval '17 minutes' AS cohort_start,
           now() - interval '2 minutes' AS cohort_end
), configured_cities(city_slug) AS (
    VALUES ('atlanta'), ('washington-dc'), ('boston'), ('new-york-city'),
           ('toronto'), ('philadelphia'), ('denver'), ('seattle'), ('unknown')
), configured_journeys(journey) AS (
    VALUES ('bootstrap_start'), ('city_map_start'), ('live_start'), ('live_resume'),

           ('audio_stop'), ('city_navigation')
), configured_environments(environment) AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM client_experience_events WHERE environment <> 'synthetic'
    UNION SELECT 'Production'
), attempts AS (
    SELECT a.environment, a.city_slug, COALESCE(a.journey, a.action) AS journey,
           a.page_session_id, a.eligible, a.logical_conflict, a.outcome
    FROM client_experience_attempts a
    CROSS JOIN parameters p
    WHERE a.environment <> 'synthetic'
      AND a.start_received_at_utc BETWEEN p.cohort_start AND p.cohort_end
), totals AS (
    SELECT environment, city_slug, journey,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE eligible AND NOT logical_conflict
               AND outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','deadline_exceeded','unresolved')) AS eligible_starts,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE eligible AND NOT logical_conflict AND outcome = 'unresolved') AS unresolved_starts,
           COUNT(DISTINCT page_session_id) FILTER (WHERE eligible AND NOT logical_conflict
               AND outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','deadline_exceeded','unresolved')) AS affected_sessions
    FROM attempts
    GROUP BY environment, city_slug, journey
), fixed_series AS (
    SELECT e.environment, c.city_slug, j.journey,
           COALESCE(t.eligible_starts, 0) AS eligible_starts,
           COALESCE(t.unresolved_starts, 0) AS unresolved_starts,
           COALESCE(t.affected_sessions, 0) AS affected_sessions
    FROM configured_environments e
    CROSS JOIN configured_cities c
    CROSS JOIN configured_journeys j
    LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.environment = e.environment AND t.city_slug = c.city_slug AND t.journey = j.journey
)
SELECT p.evaluated_at AS "time", s.environment, s.city_slug, s.journey,
       CASE WHEN s.eligible_starts >= 20 AND s.affected_sessions >= 3
                  AND s.unresolved_starts::numeric / NULLIF(s.eligible_starts, 0) > 0.10
            THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END AS value
FROM fixed_series s
CROSS JOIN parameters p
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4;

model.rawSql:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT now() AS evaluated_at,
           now() - interval '10 minutes' AS window_start,
           now() AS window_end
), configured_cities(city_slug) AS (
    VALUES ('atlanta'), ('washington-dc'), ('boston'), ('new-york-city'),
           ('toronto'), ('philadelphia'), ('denver'), ('seattle'), ('unknown')
), configured_capabilities(capability) AS (
    VALUES ('routes'), ('map'), ('live_delivery'), ('audio')
), configured_environments(environment) AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM client_experience_events WHERE environment <> 'synthetic'
    UNION SELECT 'Production'
), windows AS (
    SELECT w.event_id, w.environment, w.city_slug, w.page_session_id,
           w.observed_ms, w.gap_ms, w.state_durations,
           e.occurred_at_utc - ((e.page_elapsed_ms - w.window_start_ms) * interval '1 millisecond') AS interval_start_utc,
           e.occurred_at_utc - ((e.page_elapsed_ms - w.window_end_ms) * interval '1 millisecond') AS interval_end_utc
    FROM client_experience_validated_windows w
    JOIN client_experience_events e ON e.event_id = w.event_id
    CROSS JOIN parameters p
    WHERE NOT w.clock_skewed
      AND e.received_at_utc >= e.occurred_at_utc
      AND e.received_at_utc - e.occurred_at_utc <= interval '2 minutes'
      AND e.received_at_utc >= p.window_start - interval '2 minutes'
      AND e.page_elapsed_ms >= w.window_end_ms
      AND e.occurred_at_utc - ((e.page_elapsed_ms - w.window_start_ms) * interval '1 millisecond') >= p.window_start
      AND e.occurred_at_utc - ((e.page_elapsed_ms - w.window_end_ms) * interval '1 millisecond') <= p.window_end
), per_capability AS (
    SELECT w.event_id, w.environment, w.city_slug, w.page_session_id, w.observed_ms, w.gap_ms,
           state.value ->> 'capability' AS capability,
           SUM(NULLIF(state.value ->> 'durationMs', '')::bigint)
               FILTER (WHERE state.value ->> 'state' IN ('degraded','unavailable')) AS degraded_ms,
           SUM(NULLIF(state.value ->> 'durationMs', '')::bigint)
               FILTER (WHERE state.value ->> 'state' = 'unknown') AS unknown_ms
    FROM windows w
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(w.state_durations) state(value)
    GROUP BY w.event_id, w.environment, w.city_slug, w.page_session_id, w.observed_ms, w.gap_ms,
             state.value ->> 'capability'
), totals AS (
    SELECT environment, city_slug, capability,
           SUM(observed_ms) AS observed_ms,
           SUM(COALESCE(degraded_ms, 0)) AS degraded_ms,
           SUM(COALESCE(unknown_ms, 0)) AS unknown_ms,
           SUM(gap_ms) AS gap_ms,
           COUNT(DISTINCT page_session_id) AS affected_sessions
    FROM per_capability
    GROUP BY environment, city_slug, capability
), fixed_series AS (
    SELECT e.environment, c.city_slug, cap.capability,
           COALESCE(t.observed_ms, 0) AS observed_ms,
           COALESCE(t.degraded_ms, 0) AS degraded_ms,
           COALESCE(t.unknown_ms, 0) AS unknown_ms,
           COALESCE(t.gap_ms, 0) AS gap_ms,
           COALESCE(t.affected_sessions, 0) AS affected_sessions
    FROM configured_environments e
    CROSS JOIN configured_cities c
    CROSS JOIN configured_capabilities cap
    LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.environment = e.environment AND t.city_slug = c.city_slug AND t.capability = cap.capability
)
SELECT p.evaluated_at AS "time", s.environment, s.city_slug, s.capability AS metric,
       CASE WHEN s.observed_ms >= 600000 AND s.affected_sessions >= 3
                  AND (s.unknown_ms + s.gap_ms)::numeric / NULLIF(s.observed_ms + s.gap_ms, 0) <= 0.10
            THEN CASE WHEN s.degraded_ms::numeric / NULLIF(s.observed_ms, 0) >= 0.10
                      THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END
            ELSE NULL::double precision END AS value
FROM fixed_series s
CROSS JOIN parameters p
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4;

model.rawSql:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT now() AS evaluated_at,
           now() - interval '2 minutes' AS fresh_after
), configured_cities(city_slug) AS (
    VALUES ('atlanta'), ('washington-dc'), ('boston'), ('new-york-city'),
           ('toronto'), ('philadelphia'), ('denver'), ('seattle'), ('unknown')
), configured_environments(environment) AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM client_experience_events WHERE environment <> 'synthetic'
    UNION SELECT 'Production'
), stop_failures AS (
    SELECT e.environment, e.city_slug, COUNT(*) AS failure_count
    FROM client_experience_events e
    CROSS JOIN parameters p
    WHERE e.event_kind = 'attempt_finished'
      AND e.environment <> 'synthetic'
      AND e.payload ->> 'journey' = 'audio_stop'
      AND e.payload ->> 'outcome' = 'failed'
      AND e.payload ->> 'reason' = 'still_playing'
      AND NOT e.clock_skewed
      AND e.occurred_at_utc >= p.fresh_after
      AND e.received_at_utc >= p.fresh_after
      AND e.received_at_utc >= e.occurred_at_utc
      AND e.received_at_utc - e.occurred_at_utc <= interval '2 minutes'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM client_experience_events started
          WHERE started.event_kind = 'attempt_started'
            AND started.environment = e.environment
            AND started.page_session_id = e.page_session_id
            AND started.city_activation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.city_activation_id
            AND started.measurement_version = e.measurement_version
            AND started.attempt_id = e.attempt_id
            AND started.payload ->> 'journey' = 'audio_stop'
      )
    GROUP BY e.environment, e.city_slug
)
SELECT p.evaluated_at AS "time", env.environment, city.city_slug, 'still_playing'::text AS metric,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.failure_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END AS value
FROM configured_environments env
CROSS JOIN configured_cities city
CROSS JOIN parameters p
LEFT JOIN stop_failures f ON f.environment = env.environment AND f.city_slug = city.city_slug
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4;

model.rawSql:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT now() AS evaluated_at,
           now() - interval '5 minutes' AS errors_start,
           now() - interval '10 minutes' AS warnings_start
), configured_cities(city_slug) AS (
    VALUES ('atlanta'), ('washington-dc'), ('boston'), ('new-york-city'),
           ('toronto'), ('philadelphia'), ('denver'), ('seattle'), ('unknown')
), configured_environments(environment) AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM client_experience_events WHERE environment <> 'synthetic'
    UNION SELECT 'Production'
), presentations AS (
    SELECT environment, city_slug, page_session_id, displayed_severity, received_at_utc
    FROM client_experience_presentations
    WHERE environment <> 'synthetic'
), errors AS (
    SELECT p.environment, p.city_slug, COUNT(*) AS presentation_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.page_session_id) AS affected_sessions
    FROM presentations p CROSS JOIN parameters t
    WHERE p.displayed_severity = 'error' AND p.received_at_utc >= t.errors_start
    GROUP BY p.environment, p.city_slug
), warnings AS (
    SELECT p.environment, p.city_slug, COUNT(*) AS presentation_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.page_session_id) AS affected_sessions
    FROM presentations p CROSS JOIN parameters t
    WHERE p.displayed_severity = 'warning' AND p.received_at_utc >= t.warnings_start
    GROUP BY p.environment, p.city_slug
), fixed_series AS (
    SELECT e.environment, c.city_slug, 'error'::text AS severity,
           COALESCE(a.presentation_count, 0) AS presentation_count,
           COALESCE(a.affected_sessions, 0) AS affected_sessions,
           10::bigint AS count_threshold, 3::bigint AS session_threshold
    FROM configured_environments e CROSS JOIN configured_cities c
    LEFT JOIN errors a ON a.environment = e.environment AND a.city_slug = c.city_slug
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.environment, c.city_slug, 'warning'::text AS severity,
           COALESCE(a.presentation_count, 0) AS presentation_count,
           COALESCE(a.affected_sessions, 0) AS affected_sessions,
           30::bigint AS count_threshold, 5::bigint AS session_threshold
    FROM configured_environments e CROSS JOIN configured_cities c
    LEFT JOIN warnings a ON a.environment = e.environment AND a.city_slug = c.city_slug
)
SELECT p.evaluated_at AS "time", s.environment, s.city_slug, s.severity AS metric,
       CASE WHEN s.presentation_count >= s.count_threshold AND s.affected_sessions >= s.session_threshold
            THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END AS value
FROM fixed_series s
CROSS JOIN parameters p
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4;
